en.html:
Horigoe Maid"Yes. You called?"
Chachamaru"Take that sister over there to the storeroom."
Horigoe Maid"At once."
Muramasa"One moment."
Chachamaru"Go on, go. She will show you a nice room."
Muramasa"You clearly said STOREROOM!"
Chachamaru"Tch... Listening to unnecessary words, this one."
Muramasa"Do we have to settle this once and for all?"
Chachamaru"Aa ja, you scrap-metal maharani. Quietly into storage, that was the offer. But if madam's taste is for the scrap factory, apun can arrange that also."
Muramasa"Just try!"

ja.html:
堀越女中「はッ。 　お呼びでございましょうか」
茶々丸「そこの姉ちゃん、物置に連れてってやって」
堀越女中「はッ」
村正「ちょっと」
茶々丸「ほら、行けよ。 　その人がいい部屋に案内してくれるから」
村正「今はっきり、物置って言ったでしょうが！」
茶々丸「ち……いらねーこと聞いてやがる」
村正「とことん決着つけないとだめなのかしら」
茶々丸「上等だオラ。 　おとなしく物置に片付いてりゃいいもんを、 スクラップ工場の方が趣味だってんならそう してやる」
村正「やってみなさいよ！」

en.html:
The fire was supposed to be out. Lo, burning again.

Soul was clashing with soul.
Blazing power was colliding with blazing power.

From every possible angle, the neighbours were being harassed.

en.html:
Madam, ask for something possible, I wanted to say.
I did not say it.

My adoptive parents had brought me up too well for my own convenience.
